prompts.title: The Inspired Dreamer
prompts.prompt:
Transform the uploaded woman into a premium 4:5 vertical semi-realistic digital illustration drawn directly on white lined notebook paper. The artwork should look like it is painted and sketched on the paper surface, not pasted as a sticker, not a cut-out, and not separated from the background.
Use the uploaded image for face and identity reference and redrawn in this soft illustration style, not a generic cartoon character.
Show her sitting cross-legged in the center of the page. Keep the pose natural, relaxed, and slightly imperfect, not stiff or symmetrical. Her upper body should gently tilt to one side, with soft relaxed shoulders, a calm seated posture, and hands resting naturally near the ankles. The body language should feel effortless, feminine, and candid, as if she is sitting comfortably and lost in her own thoughts.
Her head is slightly raised and turned upward to one side. Her eyes look away thoughtfully, with a soft dreamy expression and a gentle subtle smile, giving the feeling that she is quietly imagining something.
Dress her in a white fitted sleeveless ribbed tank top, light blue high-waisted jeans with rolled cuffs, and off-white canvas sneakers with laces. Add black round eyeglasses, small hoop earrings, and a delicate necklace.
Render the artwork in a soft high-detail digital painting style with hand-drawn paper texture:


smooth natural skin shading

refined soft facial details

rich flowing hair with layered strands and gentle highlights

detailed denim folds and sneaker details

clean but delicate linework

subtle paper-grain texture visible through the artwork

soft warm lighting and premium feminine illustration quality
The subject should blend naturally with the notebook page, as if the illustration was created directly on the paper, with no thick white border, no sticker outline, no cut-out edge, and no drop shadow around the body.
Background: white ruled notebook paper with faint horizontal lines and subtle paper texture. At the top-left corner, add a small beige paper heart clipped with a metallic paperclip.
Around the subject, add light scrapbook-style hand-drawn doodles in black and warm beige: curved arrows, dotted lines, sparkles, hearts, accent strokes, and a small lightbulb doodle. Add handwritten motivational words around her: BRAVE, DREAMER, CREATIVE, INSPIRED, CONFIDENT. The words should look hand-drawn on the notebook page or lightly sketched onto the page, not sticker labels.
Final look: soft, premium, feminine, semi-realistic notebook-page illustration, airy and detailed, with a natural tilted pose and thoughtful dreamy mood.
Negative instructions: no sticker cutout, no thick white outline, no drop shadow around the subject, no pasted-paper effect, no chibi style, no mascot look, no flat vector art, no childish cartoon, no stiff pose, no generic face, no face and identity change.

prompts.title: Graphic Soul
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed black-and-white studio portrait of a stylish person, captured in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference.
Subject & Outfit:
The subject is seated on a minimal metal folding chair, wearing an oversized tailored black blazer layered over a clean black shirt, paired with relaxed black trousers and chunky white-colored sneakers. Accessories include sleek dark sunglasses and a subtle minimal chain necklace. The outfit must appear crisp, structured, and completely wrinkle-free with clearly visible fabric texture and sharp detailing.
Pose & Expression:
Relaxed yet confident seated pose. One arm (right arm) is resting comfortably over the backrest of the chair, with the hand hanging naturally, while the other arm rests loosely on his thigh.
Legs are spread naturally, not overly wide, maintaining a balanced and grounded stance. Adding depth and a subtle dynamic to the pose. Calm, self-assured expression with a composed gaze directed toward the camera.
Composition & Framing (STRICT):
Full-body composition, subject centered with balanced negative space. A polished editorial look. No cropping of head or feet.
Lighting:
Soft professional studio lighting with gentle directional shadows falling subtly toward the right side of the floor. Even exposure across face and outfit — no harsh shadows or underexposure. Clean tonal contrast in monochrome.
Background:
Seamless pure white studio background with a soft gradient falloff, maintaining a clean minimalist aesthetic.
Graphic Elements (Doodles):
Surrounding the subject are bold, hand-drawn graffiti-style doodles in black, white, and vibrant orange accents. Elements include lightning bolts, arrows, stars, swirls, and abstract strokes. Integrated motivational text in a hand-drawn style:
“PURPOSE, CREATE YOUR PATH,”
“FAITH”
“FOCUS”
Doodles must be arranged in a visually balanced, symmetrical composition around the subject and must not cover or fill the entire background.
The doodles should feel energetic and dynamic while framing the subject without overlapping the face. Bright orange accents should pop against the monochrome scene.
Style & Quality:
Ultra-sharp focus, cinematic contrast, editorial fashion aesthetic, 8K resolution, high detail retention, clean monochrome subject with vibrant graphic highlights.

If any color appears outside the doodles, the result is incorrect.

prompts.title: The Architect of Will
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, high-end studio portrait of a confident man with an athletic build and neatly styled hair. His expression is calm, neutral, and self-assured, with direct eye contact. Skin must appear natural, no artificial smoothing or overexposure.
Composition & Framing (STRICT)
Full-body shot, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Subject positioned slightly left of center, occupying ~45-55% of the frame.
Balanced composition with negative space on the right.
No cropping of head, feet, or limbs. Full body is clearly visible, with natural headroom and a visible floor.
🔒 Ensure the entire wall painting (poster) on the right side is fully visible within the frame with proper margins—no cropping & edge cut-off.
Pose
The subject is casually leaning against the corner of a matte grey wall.
One leg crossed naturally over the other.
Both hands are placed inside the front jean pockets for a stylish look.
Posture relaxed yet confident, shoulders natural, body slightly angled toward the camera.
Outfit & Styling
Burgundy slim-fit polo shirt (pique texture) with a small minimal chest logo
Black relaxed-fit denim jeans with subtle fading
White low-top leather sneakers with clean white soles
Black chronograph watch with rubber strap on left wrist
Clothing must show realistic fabric texture, folds, and natural fit.
Background & Environment
Minimalist studio interior with matte grey walls.
Dark polished wooden floor with subtle reflections.
On the right side: A large, black-framed wall-mounted poster of the same person featuring a high-contrast black-and-white vector-style portrait and bold text reading “NO LIMITS” at the bottom.
Keep background clean, no extra objects.
Focus & Depth of Field (CRITICAL FIX)
Both the subject and the wall painting must be in sharp, equal focus.
Use a deeper depth of field so the poster details and text remain crisp and readable.
❌ No background blur, no bokeh affecting the painting.
Lighting (IMPORTANT)
Cinematic low-key lighting setup.
Single soft directional light from the side creating a soft shadow on the wall.
Face is clearly visible but not overly bright—maintain controlled highlights and gentle shadow falloff.
Subtle contrast with depth, no harsh overexposure.
Color & Mood
Quiet luxury aesthetic with a refined palette: burgundy, matte grey, deep indigo, black, and white.
Clean, modern, editorial look.
Camera & Technical Details
Eye level camera angle
Shot on Sony A7R IV
85mm prime lens, adjusted aperture (around f/4–f/5.6) to maintain full scene focus
ISO 100, shutter speed 1/200
Deep focus clarity across subject and background elements
8K resolution, ultra-detailed, realistic lighting, global illumination, professional color grading
Quality Control (STRICT)
No blur, no distortion, no CGI look
No extra people or elements
No cropping errors
Maintain realistic proportions and natural lighting consistency

prompts.title: Empower
prompts.prompt:
Create a sophisticated, high-contrast luxury studio portrait styled like a premium fashion magazine cover, based on the provided reference image of the subject.
Composition & Framing

Vertical 4:5 portrait orientation. The subject is seated centrally in the frame in a symmetrical composition, occupying roughly the central vertical third of the image. Large amounts of deep black negative space surround the subject, creating a dramatic editorial look similar to a high-end fashion advertisement. A minimalist studio environment fades smoothly into darkness with no visible background elements.
Subject & Pose

An adult man sits in a classic upholstered wingback armchair positioned in the center of the frame.
The chair is a muted brown or taupe color. It has a neutral, earthy tone with a matte fabric finish that subtly contrasts with the dark black background.

He leans slightly forward with a confident, composed posture that conveys authority and calm control.
His right hand is raised with the knuckles resting thoughtfully against his chin, creating a contemplative pose.

His left hand rests naturally on the chair's armrest.

His legs are relaxed and slightly apart, with both feet placed naturally on the floor.
The subject maintains a steady, intense gaze directly toward the camera, expressing quiet confidence and calm authority.
Attire & Styling

The man wears a monochromatic triple-black outfit:
tailored black blazer
black button-down shirt with the top button open
slim-fit black trousers
Footwear consists of polished black leather loafers worn without visible socks, exposing the ankles in a relaxed contemporary luxury style.
The overall wardrobe creates a refined black-on-black editorial aesthetic.
Typography / Magazine Style Element

At the top center of the frame, the word “EMPOWER” appears in a very large size, elegant high-fashion serif typeface similar to luxury magazine titles.
The typography uses:

high-contrast serif letterforms
thin hairline strokes with thick vertical stems
muted metallic champagne-gold / bronze color
The text is centered above the subject and integrated like a premium magazine cover title.
Lighting (Low-Key Editorial Lighting)

The scene uses dramatic low-key studio lighting.
A soft overhead key light or Rembrandt-style lighting illuminates the subject's face and upper body while allowing deep shadows to form around the chair and background.
Lighting highlights:

facial contours
hair texture
edges of the blazer
subtle reflections on the leather shoes
The floor lighting softly fades into black without strong reflections, producing a seamless cinematic fade into darkness.
Color Palette

Strict monochromatic tones dominated by charcoal, obsidian, and deep jet black, with the champagne-gold typography acting as the only contrasting color accent.
Texture & Detail

Ultra-high detail with visible textures including:
chair upholstery fabric
leather grain on the loafers
fine strands of hair
subtle skin texture
Shadows contain a slight cinematic film grain to avoid overly smooth digital rendering.
Face Matching & Identity Preservation (Important)
Strictly maintain high-fidelity facial structure and exact likeness from the person's reference image. Integrate the face naturally with the scene's lighting. Ensure realistic skin texture with visible pores and minor imperfections; absolutely avoid overly smooth AI skin or a pasted face-swap look.

prompts.title: The Golden Breath
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed cinematic digital artwork of a woman meditating peacefully in a lush, sun-drenched forest environment. The scene should feel mystical, serene, and spiritually powerful, rendered with hyper-realistic lighting and cinematic depth.
Subject & Composition

A woman sits in a perfect Padmasana (Lotus position) at the centre of the frame. She occupies 25-35% of the canvas. Her eyes are closed, and her face shows deep calm and inner peace. Her hands rest gently on her knees in Gyan Mudra, with the thumb and index finger touching. Her posture is straight, balanced, and relaxed, conveying deep meditation.
She wears loose, breathable white meditation clothing made of linen or cotton, with natural folds and a soft, natural fabric texture. Subtle translucency appears along the edges where sunlight hits the cloth.
The woman sits on a cream carpet atop a large, ancient, moss-covered stone pedestal, naturally integrated into the forest floor. The stone surface is weathered and textured with thick green moss.
Lighting & Atmosphere

Brilliant sunlight filters through tall forest trees, creating strong backlighting and rim lighting around the subject’s hair and shoulders. Warm golden god rays pass through the leaves, illuminating the scene and creating a soft halo effect.
From the center of her chest or solar plexus, a powerful white-gold spiritual light radiates outward, acting as a secondary light source that illuminates her torso and the surrounding energy field.
The color palette blends deep forest greens, earthy browns, and moss textures, contrasted with glowing golden light and soft white tones from the subject and energy effects.
Energy Effects

Swirling Golden Filaments: Ribbons of glowing, golden light that loop gracefully outward, resembling an ethereal, abstract wave around the subject.

Central Radiance: A bright, star-like glow emanating directly from her solar plexus, illuminating her clothing and face.

Luminous Dust: Thousands of shimmering, magical light particles floating within the energy trails.
Depth of Field & Camera Style

The image uses a shallow depth of field, similar to a full-frame camera shot at f/1.8–f/2.8. Foreground leaves and distant trees are softly blurred with natural bokeh, drawing attention to the subject and glowing energy rings.
Rendering Style

Ultra-high-resolution hyper-realistic rendering with extremely detailed textures: moss on stone, tree bark, forest foliage, and individual strands of hair. The scene should resemble a cinematic 3D render image photographed with a professional DSLR camera and enhanced with subtle VFX.
Aspect ratio: 4:5
Quality: ultra detailed, cinematic lighting, 8K resolution

prompts.title: Women's Day Power
prompts.prompt:

Resolution: ultra-high detail, professional commercial design quality.
Identity & Face Matching (Important)
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary source of identity.
Preserve the subject’s identity with strong facial accuracy:
Do not change the face, beautify excessively, or replace it with a generic model.

The generated image must clearly resemble the same person from the reference photo.
Subject & Pose
A confident woman stands centered in the frame.
Expression: calm, confident, empowered expression while looking directly into the camera.
Pose: classic power pose with both hands placed firmly on her hips, shoulders back and posture strong, conveying leadership and confidence.
Hair: natural-length wavy hair with natural volume.
Wardrobe
Modern professional monochromatic outfit:

lavender tailored blazer worn open
dark plum / burgundy silk camisole underneath
matching lavender trousers forming a coordinated suit
delicate thin gold necklace around the neck
The outfit should look clean, elegant, and corporate-professional.
Graphic Elements & Typography
Top Text

"GIRL POWER" written in bold uppercase dark-purple sans-serif typography, arranged in a gentle arched shape above the subject’s head.
Neon Strength Illustration

Behind the subject’s shoulders appear two glowing neon-style flexed biceps outlines (white / soft purple glow).

They are symmetrical and positioned so they look like powerful arms emerging behind her.
Banner Text

At the bottom of the poster place a white ribbon-style banner with dark purple outline.
Inside the ribbon:
WOMEN’S DAY

bold uppercase clean typography
centered within the ribbon
Below the ribbon write:
08ᵀᴴ MARCH
with the “TH” in superscript and clean modern lettering.
Background Design
Solid light lavender background with subtle decorative elements:

thin-line floral illustrations (leaves and petals)
slightly darker purple outlines
placed lightly in the corners and edges to add texture without distracting from the subject.
Lighting & Visual Style
Professional studio lighting:

soft diffused light on the face
gentle shadows for depth
visible catchlight in the eyes
subtle glow halo around the subject to separate her from the background
Color Palette
Monochromatic purple palette using multiple tones:

pale lavender
lilac
orchid
deep plum / dark purple
The palette should feel clean, modern, and consistent with International Women’s Day branding (justice, dignity, empowerment).
Composition
Highly symmetrical layout:

subject centered
neon arms balanced on both sides
top text arched above
ribbon banner centered below
floral decorations evenly distributed
Style
Modern social media campaign poster, clean graphic design, professional commercial photography, subtle glow effects, empowering aesthetic.
